figurative_meaning_en: To have a mischievous or evil idea pressing on one's mind
similar_in_english: Have an evil spirit possessing you
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার মাথায় ভূত চাপা পড়েছে, তাই এমন দুষ্টুমি করছে।
এই কাজটা করার আগে তার ঘাড়ে ভূত চাপা হয়েছে বলে মনে হচ্ছে।
example_sentences_in_english: A ghost has possessed his mind, that's why he's up to such mischief.
It seems like a devil is on his shoulder before doing this naughty deed.
history: This idiom draws from Bengali folk beliefs in ghosts (bhoot) possessing people, often linked to rural superstitions about spirits causing erratic or mischievous behavior.
note: The idiom reflects widespread cultural fears of supernatural influence on human actions in Bengali society.
